versions.title: First Release
versions.summary: Wobbly bobble-heads fight endless zombies. Play alone or with up to four friends.
versions.intro: Flopocalypse comes to the Firefly Launcher! You are a wobbly bobble-head. They are zombies. Everybody flops.

sections.title: New
items: Co-op lobbies|Walk into a circle, pick a map and difficulty, and take up to four friends with you.
Ragdoll everything|Zombies flop when you hit them, then burn away into embers.
20 weapons and 34 enemies|Upgrade weapons three times over, and survive bosses every 15 waves.
